My analysis is complete. The implementation is a minimal single-user bookmark app: save with duplicate detection, title/description metadata only, add-labels, label filtering, substring search over title+description, read/unread toggling, and archive/restore. No delete, no title/description/url/note editing, no favicon/preview, no tag autocomplete, no boolean/#tag/phrase search, no unread-only view, no sort control, no bulk actions, no notes, no snapshots, no bundles, no import/export, no settings.

}
